description: This file defines models and database views for the 'report_account_analytic_planning' module in an Odoo (OpenERP) project, including classes for planning, planning lines, and various statistical reports related to analytic accounts and user activities.

classes.name: report_account_analytic.planning
classes.description: Model representing a planning with associated lines and statistics.

classes.name: report_account_analytic.planning.line
classes.description: Model representing individual planning lines linked to analytic accounts and users.

classes.name: report_account_analytic.planning.stat.account
classes.description: View model for statistics per analytic account, including real hours from timesheets.

classes.name: report_account_analytic.planning.stat
classes.description: View model for statistics per user and account, including planned hours, timesheets, and tasks.

classes.name: report_account_analytic.planning.stat.user
classes.description: View model for statistics per user, including planned hours and timesheets.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a planning record with reset statistics.

methods.name: _sum_amount_real
methods.description: Calculates total hours from account analytic lines for a given account and planning period.

methods.name: _sum_amount_tasks
methods.description: Calculates total planned hours from project tasks for a given account and planning period.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates or replaces SQL views for statistical reporting models.
